name: Handling Disagreements Politely
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on handling disagreements politely — practice these key phrases out loud:
I understand your point, but I see it differently.
Let's agree to disagree on this one.
Can we find some middle ground here?
I appreciate you hearing me out on this.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
